# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## What this is

A personal NixOS configuration for two machines, built with the [Dendritic pattern](https://vic.github.io/dendrix/Dendritic.html) using [`github:vic/den`](https://github.com/vic/den) and [`flake-parts`](https://flake.parts/). All Nix modules under `modules/` are auto-imported via `import-tree`.

**Do not edit `flake.nix` directly** — it is auto-generated by `flake-file`. Edit the files under `modules/flake/` instead, then run `nix run .#write-flake` to regenerate it.

## Commands

`just` is the task runner. Run `just` or `just help` to list recipes.

| Command | Alias | What it does |
|---------|-------|-------------|
| `just switch` | `just s` | Rebuild and switch (current host) |
| `just boot` | `just b` | Rebuild and set boot entry |
| `just build` | `just bd` | Build without activating |
| `just test` | `just t` | Test configuration |
| `just fmt` | `just f` | Format all files (`nix fmt`) |
| `just check` | `just c` | `nix flake check` |
| `just update` | — | Update all flake inputs |
| `just generate` | `just g` | Regenerate generated files |
| `just sops-update [FILE]` | `just sou` | Update SOPS keys on secrets |
| `just system-update` | `just su` | generate + update + switch |
| `just generations` | `just ge` | Show NixOS generations |

For remote/specific hosts: `just host::switch HOST`, `just host::boot HOST`, `just host::build HOST`.

Enter the dev shell with `nix develop` — it includes nixd, nixfmt, statix, deadnix, jujutsu, nh, just, treefmt, deploy-rs, etc.

## Architecture

### Module layout

```
modules/
  aspects/        # Feature bundles (Dendritic aspects)
  flake/          # flake-parts config (flake inputs, formatter, devshell, overlays, etc.)
  hosts/          # Per-host configuration
    andromeda/    # Lenovo ThinkPad T14 Gen 4 — desktop workstation (AMD GPU, ZFS + impermanence)
    horologium/   # Lenovo ThinkPad T14 Gen 4 — laptop (LUKS encryption, fingerprint reader)
  users/
    aniket/       # Primary user config (aspects to include per-host, sops keys, SSH keys)
    hass/         # Home Assistant service user
  defaults.nix    # Global NixOS/homeManager defaults applied to all hosts
  namespace.nix   # Declares the `blazar` namespace
packages/         # Custom packages (auto-exported via pkgs-by-name-for-flake-parts)
secrets/          # SOPS-encrypted secrets (user-passwords.yaml, keys.yaml)
```

### Dendritic / den concepts

- **Namespace**: `blazar` (declared in `modules/namespace.nix`). All aspects live under `blazar.<name>`.
- **Aspects** (`modules/aspects/`): self-contained feature modules. Defined with `blazar.<name>.nixos`, `blazar.<name>.homeManager`, etc. Reference other aspects in `includes = with blazar; [...]`.
- **Hosts** (`den.hosts.x86_64-linux.<hostname>`): defined in `modules/hosts/<name>/system.nix`. Declare which users they have and which aspects are active.
- **Users** (`den.aspects.<username>`): defined in `modules/users/<name>/user.nix`. The `includes` list in the user aspect drives which feature aspects apply.
- **Defaults** (`den.default.*`): settings in `modules/defaults.nix` and `modules/aspects/defaults.nix` propagate to all hosts/users.
- **`den.schema`**: controls aspect routing, e.g. which classes get pulled into flake-parts outputs.

### How features are composed

The user `aniket` (`modules/users/aniket/user.nix`) lists aspects to include via `includes = with blazar; [ai, cli, desktop, ...]`. Host-specific aspects are added conditionally:

```nix
++ (lib.optional (host.name == "andromeda") [ hyprland ])
++ (lib.optional (host.name == "horologium") [ plasma ])
```

### Host-specific notes

- **andromeda**: ZFS root with impermanence (`/persist`); SSH host keys live in `/persist/etc/ssh/`; includes `stylix`, `impermanence`, `determinate-nix` aspects.
- **horologium**: LUKS-encrypted root with GRUB; includes `stylix`, `determinate-nix` aspects; fingerprint reader via custom `libfprint-goodixtls-55x4` package.

### Secrets

Secrets are managed with `sops-nix`. Encrypted files live in `secrets/`. Update keys with `just sops-update` (or `just sou secrets/<file>`). The SOPS GPG keys are derived from SSH host keys (`/persist/etc/ssh/ssh_host_rsa_key` on andromeda, `/etc/ssh/ssh_host_rsa_key` on horologium).

### Formatter

`nix fmt` runs treefmt with: `nixfmt` (Nix), `deadnix` + `statix` (Nix linting), `shellcheck` (shell), `ruff` (Python), `taplo` + `toml-sort` (TOML), `mdformat` (Markdown). Configuration is in `modules/flake/formatter.nix`.

### Overlays

`modules/defaults.nix` defines a `latestPackages` overlay that pulls selected packages from `nixpkgs-unstable` (e.g. `_1password-gui`, `tailscale`, `jetbrains`, `kstars`, `obs-studio`) into the stable nixpkgs set.
